title: An OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint
summary:
OpenAI-compatible chat, new text model options, and even a route in for Flash widgets.

Added POST `/v1/chat/completions` for streaming and non-streaming chat requests in OpenAI-compatible formats.

DeepSeek joined text generation, and `openai-reasoning` moved from o1-mini to o3-mini with vision listed as supported. Token-limited o1-mini requests now use its supported parameter. Images gained an SDXL fallback when Cloudflare Flux fails, while short prompts are no longer automatically enhanced.

Added cross-domain policy responses for the text and image services, allowing Flash widgets on older devices such as Chumby and Sony Dash to make requests.

highlights.title: OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint
highlights.text: Send streaming or non-streaming chat requests to `/v1/chat/completions` using OpenAI-compatible request and response formats. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: More text model options
highlights.text: DeepSeek was added to text generation, and `openai-reasoning` now routes to o3-mini with vision support listed. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: Flash widgets can connect
highlights.text: Cross-domain policies let Flash-based widgets, including those on Chumby and Sony Dash, request text and images. Old hardware gets another job.
